definition: Company-reported GAAP revenue for the stated reporting entity and period.
scope_constraints: company_consolidated_or_explicit_reporting_segment; same scope and presentation definition required
interpretation_limits: Not product revenue unless source scope states product; revenue is not bookings or billings.
stability_notes: Segment presentation definitions FY2024/FY2025 must stay separate; identical name is insufficient.

definition: Company-reported GAAP operating income; excludes a company non-GAAP operating result unless separately mapped.
interpretation_limits: Company costs and classification policy may differ; not EBITDA or net income.
stability_notes: Versioned source policy and scope required; no retrospective overwrite

definition: Company-reported GAAP net income for the stated ownership/consolidation scope.
interpretation_limits: Net income vs net income attributable to parent are distinct if source ownership scopes differ.
stability_notes: Versioned source policy and scope required; no retrospective overwrite

definition: Company-reported net cash from operating activities for the stated cash-flow period.
interpretation_limits: CFO includes reported reconciliation; net income or a balance change is not CFO.
stability_notes: Versioned source policy and scope required; no retrospective overwrite

definition: Positive cash amount paid for the selected property and equipment purchase line; normalize explicit cash outflow sign only.
sign_convention: cash payment positive after guarded sign normalization
interpretation_limits: Excludes finance-lease acquisitions and noncash investment; investing cash flow total is not capex; source line inclusion must be explicit.
stability_notes: Versioned source policy and scope required; no retrospective overwrite

definition: Company-reported total assets at the stated balance-sheet date.
interpretation_limits: Point-in-time balance, never a quarter/YTD flow.
stability_notes: Versioned source policy and scope required; no retrospective overwrite

definition: Company-reported cash and cash equivalents at the stated balance-sheet date.
interpretation_limits: Do not add short-term investments or restricted cash silently.
stability_notes: Versioned source policy and scope required; no retrospective overwrite

definition: Project-defined CFO minus positive cash PP&E capex with identical entity, period and currency.
sign_convention: CFO source sign minus positive cash capex
interpretation_limits: This project definition is not an observed company FCF; cash line inclusion and all inputs required.
stability_notes: Versioned source policy and scope required; no retrospective overwrite

definition: Reserved company-defined FCF; definition and reconciliation pending an explicit Microsoft source.
interpretation_limits: Same name is not equivalent to project FCF or another company FCF.
stability_notes: Versioned source policy and scope required; no retrospective overwrite

definition: Reserved company-defined FCF; definition and reconciliation pending an explicit NVIDIA source.
interpretation_limits: Same name is not equivalent to project FCF or another company FCF.
stability_notes: Versioned source policy and scope required; no retrospective overwrite

definition: GAAP operating income divided by positive GAAP revenue for identical company, scope and reporting period.
interpretation_limits: Percentage level is not percentage-point change; GAAP/non-GAAP margins separate.
stability_notes: Versioned source policy and scope required; no retrospective overwrite

definition: Maximum stated production capability for a specific product, facility, unit and effective period.
interpretation_limits: Capacity is not actual production or shipments; no semiconductor-only scope assumption.
stability_notes: Versioned source policy and scope required; no retrospective overwrite

definition: Reported quantity actually produced for a stated product, unit and period.
interpretation_limits: Capacity, production and shipments retain distinct IDs; yield and inventory not assumed.
stability_notes: Versioned source policy and scope required; no retrospective overwrite

definition: Reported quantity shipped for a stated product, unit and period.
interpretation_limits: Shipment is not sale or revenue recognition; no units inferred from revenue.
stability_notes: Versioned source policy and scope required; no retrospective overwrite
